notes.title: 【Online mode now available】The 0.9.9 version is here!
notes.content:
Hello everyone! Time flies so fast. After two months of hard work, the 0.9.9 version of Master Of Pottery has finally been developed. Now you can get the latest update on Steam! This update focuses on updating the online mode, now you can share your work with other players! At the same time, some optimizations and changes have been made to the existing system. The detailed updates are as follows:

New: Online mode, you can visit each other's showroom with friends or other players in this mode. After another player purchases your work, you will get online mode currency, which can be used to exchange for unique decoration materials, and Visiting a friend’s showroom will receive a random amount of monetary rewards.

The online mode opening conditions: the number of exhibited works is not less than 5, and the number of days is greater than 35.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36088335/484dfb00ac717726ca82892cb5cc67c503545e22.jpg
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36088335/7eb3038d1aa5ddf0d9a7c60322c23aff0ff15b2c.jpg

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36088335/7bb48d68ca01702a2a8aa7575bbbb385c8edf825.jpg

New: a exchange store includes a new floor, booth and rest area, and a [touch screen] that displays the current exhibits in real time has been added.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36088335/290eb11e0bbe2e0592c0ae8f26e53db7f8fcddfc.jpg

New: a background music in online mode.

Optimization: Added an automatic backup system, which automatically generates backup archives and automatically loads them when the main archive is damaged, reducing the possibility of a few players' archives disappearing.

Optimization: Fixed some known bugs.

notes.title: 2020.6.29 Major update
notes.content:
Weather system:
You can make, display, and sell works in 4 weather types: sunny, cloudy, light rain, and heavy rain. All 3d scenes will change with the weather, and more types of weather may be added in the future.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36088335/0e09df1a01a6beb9e0ccf10bf6ee1f5bc4fe89f9.jpg

 Decoration system: 
You can buy different styles of decoration materials in the decoration shop, including walls, exhibition booths, floors, roofs, plants, seating areas, etc., and change the appearance of the exhibition hall through different combinations. There are not many decoration materials at present, and new materials will be gradually updated in the future.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36088335/74aa2afb7580047a7b19a7bbc64b6fcfb426e483.jpg

Apprentice system:
Brand new simulation business gameplay! After your reputation (showroom heat) reaches a certain value, you may receive [Apprentice Letter], after enrolling apprentices, you can use your existing works to teach them (just give your work to them), the apprentice will Imitate your works to create, with the increase of experience, the apprentice's craft becomes stronger. Eventually, the apprentice will give you a gift [raw material] after the apprenticeship, which will be used to purchase decoration assets, and will also increase your reputation.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36088335/bced59624dbaa552725a2276decf977c4650c23d.jpg

-Improved the picture quality, with the realistic light and shadow, you can see the scenery outside the window, the light changes with time during the exhibition.
-A new background music in showroom.
-You can rotate works in collection mode.
-Fixed a bug that some works could not be viewed.

notes.title: 2020.2.19 Update
notes.content:
-Add gesture size control, you can control the range of gestures with the mouse wheel.
-Fixed known bugs.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36088335/30b0a81910075c0f88684313de830195d30c0131.png

notes.title: 2020.2.15 Update
notes.content: -Solve the problem of "fatal error in gc".

notes.title: 2020.2.12 Update
notes.content:
-Add [Smooth] gesture to make the surface of the work more rounded
-Add cursor style on click
-Fixed some bugs

notes.title: 2020.2.11 Update
notes.content:
-The resolution option has been modified to solve the problem that the resolution of some players gradually becomes lower.
-Fixed the issue that the textures of some works in collection mode moved up.

notes.title: 2020.1.23 Update
notes.content:
-Increased brush density options.
-Added 5 Chinese patterns and two "Fu" patterns for the Spring Festival.
-happy Lunar New Year!

notes.title: 2019.11.23 Update
notes.content:
- Added a new scene for making pottery, unlocked by some conditions.
- Increase resolution settings and windowing options in the game settings.
- Add a new material and two blue and white patterns.

notes.title: 2019.11.17 update
notes.content:
-Fixed a bug where some works had errors displayed.
-Fixed a bug where the progress of the warm-up session was always 0%.
-Increased the frame rate of some scenes.
